4. The trial Court by considering the evidence on record held the accused guilty of the offences charged and thereby convicted and sentenced him to undergo imprisonment as per the impugned judgment of conviction and order of sentence.

The testimony of the prosecutrix in the present case thus has failed to inspire absolute confidence of the Trial Court, the High Court and this court as well."
